collect.ifAbsent: the run stops before the first method call with the run failure `run failed: plugin: plugin "<name>" declares no collect`, because without the claim set there is no build and no documentation is written

resolution.ifAbsent: the run stops before the first method call with the run failure `run failed: plugin: plugin "<name>" declares no resolution`, because a plugin without it cannot be used

derivability.ifAbsent: the redundancy ban is skipped and the report says it was skipped, so a claim a declaration already states is kept rather than silently dropped

bivalence.ifAbsent: no claim may take the scenario channel, so every claim whose assertion could be checked is an error rather than a pass

execution.ifAbsent: scenarios are parsed and bound but never run, so every scenario-channel claim is an error rather than a pass

citation.ifAbsent: a `because` claim cannot resolve its reference, so it is an error rather than a pass

surface.ifAbsent: the report carries no uncovered-symbol section and says the plugin declared no surface, rather than reporting that every public symbol is covered

mapping.spawn: no plugin process is running: the run is a run failure printed as `run failed: plugin: <loss>` on stderr with exit code 2, no .veridoc/result.json is written, and no claim is given an outcome
mapping.eof: the plugin closed its stdout with a call in flight: the same run failure and exit code 2, with the plugin's own stderr lines repeated as `plugin said: …`
mapping.exited: the plugin ended itself with a call in flight: the same run failure and exit code 2, naming the exit status the plugin left
mapping.killed: veridoc ended the plugin, by deadline or by interrupt: the same run failure and exit code 2, attributed to the host rather than to the project
mapping.noAnswer: the wait passed with the request waiting: for `run` the scenario is a run failure of kind `deadline` carrying its own millisecond figure, and for any other method the run is a run failure with exit code 2
mapping.unusable-result: the plugin answered a method in a shape vd/1 cannot read: the plugin counts as lost, so the run is a run failure with exit code 2 and `veridoc install-plugin` records nothing

rules.expectation: collect answers an instance of docs/schema/vd-1/collect-result.json that reports at least one claim of the emitted project and names no skipped sidecar.

resolve answers every subject collect reported with a non-empty referentId and signature, and answers the reference src/__veridoc_absent__.ts|absentSymbol — which names nothing in any project — as unresolved with a reason, never as resolved.
derivable answers at least one fact a reader can already see in the declaration, for the referentId of a symbol collect declared.
bivalence answers bivalent false for each of the emitted project's four negative probes, and bivalent true by the method the project names for its one positive probe.

run answers an instance of docs/schema/vd-1/run-response.json with ok true, a value for every observable the emitted project declares, one satisfied answer for every leaf id the engine issued, and no field named outcome anywhere.
cite resolves the store and id the emitted project declares, with non-empty text, rather than answering that it is unresolved.
surface, asked with no params at all, answers an instance of docs/schema/vd-1/surface-result.json naming at least one referent of the emitted project.
